act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Oh, I didn't expect to run into you here. I just finished my work report.
Hmm... Lemme think. Everything has gone well enough. Thanks for your concern.
That said, I haven't quite slept enough recently, so my mind feels a bit foggy.
Good thing I don't talk much anyway, so I didn't make any obvious slip-ups. Otherwise, I might have ran into some trouble.

dialogue.sit: Get some rest when you have the chance!
